sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.239/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Rehatgaon, District Harda, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 368, 376(2)(n), 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offence Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 11.05.2023.
He submits that after lodging a missing report by the parents of the prosecutrix, she was recovered and then her first statement was recorded in which the allegation of rape was not there.
He submits that after developing the story, the prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 164 of the CrPC has made allegation against the applicant for commission of rape with her.

He also submits that there is Abhishek Kawade vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172135481/
1 nothing in the MLC.

entities.text: Abhishek Kawade vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence.
Therefore, he prays that the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed the prayer of bail and submitted that looking to the nature of offence committed by the applicant, this application deserves dismissal.
Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of case diary

,
I am disposing of this application directing the applicant to revive the prayer of bail after recording the statement of prosecutrix.
The trial Court is also directed to expedite the trial and make all endeavours to get the statement of prosecutrix recorded as early as possible within a period of three months.
However, within the given time if statement of prosecutrix is not recorded, then the applicant will be at liberty to revive his prayer of bail.
With the aforesaid, the application stands disposed of.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Devashish DEVASHISH MISHRA 2023.06.21 11:49:08 +05'30'
